info.title: meshnote
info.description: An agent-native second brain. A CLI + MCP server implementing the LLM Wiki pattern, with multiple project templates for research, book companions, personal journals, and team knowledge.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: meshnote — an agent-native knowledge base for LLMs.

options.name: --name
options.description: Human-readable project name. Defaults to the directory name.

options.name: --template
options.description: Project template: custom, research, book, personal, or business. Defaults to custom. [default: custom]

options.name: --description
options.description: One-line description shown in the project picker.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory to initialize. Must not already contain a meshnote project. [default: <path>]

commands.name: add
commands.description: Register an existing meshnote project directory.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory of an existing meshnote project.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Unregister a project (does not delete files).

arguments.name: SLUG
arguments.description: Slug of the project to unregister. Files on disk are left alone.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project slug. Defaults to the current directory if it's a meshnote project, or the only registered project if exactly one is known.

commands.name: read
commands.description: Print a wiki page to stdout.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project slug. Defaults to the current directory if it's a meshnote project, or the only registered project if exactly one is known.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Relative path of the page (e.g. `wiki/entities/Karpathy.md`) or its title.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project slug. Defaults to the current directory if it's a meshnote project, or the only registered project if exactly one is known.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Download a URL and register it as a raw source.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project slug. Defaults to the current directory if it's a meshnote project, or the only registered project if exactly one is known.

options.name: --title
options.description: Optional human-readable title. Defaults to the URL's last segment.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Launch the local web viewer at http://localhost:<port>/.
